responsibility: Implements GCC’s JSON parser, turning UTF-8 text into the internal json::value tree defined in json.{h,cc}. It owns the lexer and recursive-descent parser for JSON tokens, including string escape handling, integer and floating-point number parsing, object/array construction, literal recognition, optional comment acceptance, and EOF/grammar validation. The file also builds detailed parse errors with source ranges and line/column information through json::location_map, records value-to-source ranges when requested, exposes the parse_utf8_string entry points declared in the header, and contains selftests covering successful parses and diagnostic paths.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation behind the interface in json-parsing.h: the concrete lexer and recursive-descent parser classes, tokenization and UTF-8 decoding logic, parse error construction, location-range recording during parsing, the parse_utf8_string function bodies, and parser selftests. Unlike the header, it is the executable parser implementation rather than the public API and type declarations.
